value.rationale: A natural symmetric-source reconstruction code problem is completely solved for all q and all lengths with an explicit optimum, direct code construction, and forest-component classification. It quantifies the exact improvement from one to two distinct deletion reads by factor (q+1)/2 at odd length and exhibits power-of-two conflict trees. Structural explanation and finite alphabet-wide theorem go beyond mere code enumeration or a trivial normalization.
